goal: An agent task shows missing required information before it starts, and skill-creator can draft gated agile skills that stay disabled until they pass validation
scenarios: before an agent task starts, HuntianLing injects WorkItem context, tree, milestone, acceptance, tech profile, source documents, prior feedback, tool permissions, and checks
missing required information is visible before the task starts
the task does not start while required information is missing
a completed agent run returns structured feedback, assumptions, open questions, evidence references, and next actions
skill-creator drafts a skill from an agile template
the catalog covers intake, analysis, story splitting, acceptance, planning, review, QA, release, documentation, and retrospective skills
the skill validator records results in agent_skill_validations
an invalid or unvalidated draft cannot be enabled for agent execution
constraints: skill drafts stay gated until they pass validation
customers cannot inspect agent task context or manage skill drafts
nonGoals: auto-enabling drafted skills as live runtime agents
